messages.author: e616e19cf68e4d4a
messages.subject: abbreviate boxplot depiction
parts:
Hello Everyone,

Is it possible to graph only the first, second, and third quartiles,
without the min/max and outliers? One or two of my boxplots have
outliers that make the y axis increase too much distorting boxplot
comparisons. Shortening ylim unfortunately eliminates some data and
changes the median, so this is not an option.

thanks,

Josh

messages.author: 70ab9fabb9f066d8
messages.subject: Re: abbreviate boxplot depiction
parts:
Hi Josh,

It might be easiest to calculate the stats on your own then plot them:

df <- data.frame(x = 1:5, y = exp(rnorm(1000)))

# your problem as I understand it - outliers take up most of the plot area
qplot(x, y, data = df, geom = "boxplot", group = x)

# calculate quartiles
sum.df <- ddply(df, "x", function(df) quantile(df$y, probs = c(0.25,
0.5, 0.75)))
# and plot
qplot(x, `50%`, ymin = `25%`, ymax = `75%`, data = sum.df, geom = "crossbar")

Charlotte
